name: ipgeolocation-io-mcp
description: Official MCP server for IP geolocation, security indicators, abuse contacts, ASN, time zones, astronomy, and user-agent parsing.
long_description: Use IPGeolocation.io APIs from an MCP client or host that can launch a local stdio command. Provides 16 API tools and a zero-credit cached-result reader; endpoint and module access depends on the API plan. Bulk tools accept 250 inputs by default, set by the lower of the input and result item limits. Oversized successful results use cached JSON pages, preserving nested arrays and individual records. Read pages with the same process and API key before idle expiry or eviction; unavailable cursors fail locally without another API call.

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Geolocation for a public IPv4/IPv6 address; domain lookup requires a paid plan

tools.name: bulk_lookup_ip
tools.description: Bulk IP geolocation, up to 250 inputs per MCP request by default

tools.name: get_my_ip
tools.description: Returns the public egress IP of the machine running this server

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Company details and ASN ownership for an IP; free plans return basic ASN only

tools.name: lookup_currency
tools.description: Currency and country metadata for a public IP address

tools.name: lookup_network
tools.description: BGP route prefix, connection type, and anycast indicator

tools.name: check_security
tools.description: IP security indicators, including VPN, proxy, Tor, bot flags, and threat scores

tools.name: bulk_security_check
tools.description: Bulk security check, up to 250 inputs per MCP request by default

tools.name: get_timezone
tools.description: Timezone lookup by IANA name, coordinates, IP, or airport code

tools.name: get_astronomy
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, twilight, and moon phases

tools.name: get_astronomy_time_series
tools.description: Daily astronomy data for a date range up to 90 days

tools.name: parse_user_agent
tools.description: Parse a user-agent string into device, browser, OS details

tools.name: bulk_parse_user_agent
tools.description: Bulk parse up to 250 user-agent strings per MCP request by default

tools.name: lookup_asn
tools.description: ASN details with optional peers, upstreams, downstreams, routes, and WHOIS

tools.name: get_abuse_contact
tools.description: Abuse contact email, phone, and address for a public IP

tools.name: get_cached_result
tools.description: Read or replay a cached JSON page with the same process and API key; no API call or credits

credentials.justification: Authenticate IP intelligence, time zone, astronomy, ASN, abuse, and user-agent lookups, which can consume API credits. The server keeps the key in process memory without writing it to disk or refreshing it. The client or host controls its own credential storage.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your ipgeolocation.io API key. Get one free at https://app.ipgeolocation.io/signup

request_timeout_ms.title: Request timeout (ms)
request_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time allowed for an upstream API request.

cache_ttl_ms.title: Cache TTL (ms)
cache_ttl_ms.description: Time-to-live for cached tool responses; successful cached-page reads extend their idle expiry.

cache_max_entries.title: Maximum cache entries
cache_max_entries.description: Maximum cached responses and page snapshots. This limits entry count, not total bytes or memory.

max_bulk_items.title: Maximum bulk items
max_bulk_items.description: Bulk input ceiling. The actual batch limit is the lower of this setting and Maximum result items.

max_result_items.title: Maximum result items
max_result_items.description: Bulk input/result item ceiling. Complete nested arrays are retained; large successful results use cached pagination.

max_response_chars.title: Maximum response bytes
max_response_chars.description: Maximum UTF-8 size of a complete serialized tool result, including text and structured content. Larger successful results use cached pagination without additional API calls; error messages are shortened while retaining status and guidance.

max_error_chars.title: Maximum error characters
max_error_chars.description: Upper character limit for the error message, excluding truncation markers and guidance. The complete response byte limit can shorten the message further.
